text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
After this... could I have a moment of 
your time, please?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I only need one more stamp to fill up my 
goshuincho, so I'd like to go get it. And 
soâ

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For the very last one, I just wanted to 
give it everything I had.
choice_data_list: Does that mean going really far away?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But since I'm unfamiliar with this, 
I can't quite tell what is realistic... Do 
you know of any good places to go?

Hearing the details, a certain place 
immediately came to mind.
choice_data_list: How about Kyoto... or somewhere like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Kyoto.

While it's a familiar place during races, 
conversely, one rarely goes there outside 
of them. Above all—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to Kyoto, you'll need to 
take the Shinkansen.
choice_data_list:
Ah... Is that pushing it a bit too far, 
though?

Yeah... maybe that's pushing it a bit too 
far.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No. Let's go—to Kyoto. Let's take the 
plunge.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ――Let's ride the Shinkansen!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Given the time, we ought to buy boxed 
lunches. ...Since it's a special occasion, 
let's get something fit for a departure.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
... ...'Grilled Splendid Alfonsino Bento', 
1500 yen.

text_block_list.name: Conductor
text_block_list.text:
"Presently, on the right side of our 
direction of travel, you can see a 
panoramic view of Mt. Fuji. Though it will 
only be for a brief moment, please enjoy—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. Can you see it too, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, perfect. That's a good omen.
Yeah, perfect. That's a great sign.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...It's been a long time since I took 
such a close look. Usually, my head is 
full of racing."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It's magnificent, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A dry landscape garden... Sublime and 
tranquil... It brings such peace to the 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well then, let us go. The goshuin 
stamp office is just ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: We're boxed in.
We're boxed in, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I am surprised.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I truly never thought it would fill up. 
Nor did I think I'd casually wander out to 
such a distant place.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(May this journey help me grow in at least 
one way.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Have I grown, I wonder? Compared to 
when I first began this journey.
choice_data_list: I am! I've grown so much bigger!

text_block_list.text:
After all, a spontaneous trip used to mean 
two stations over, but now it means 
hopping on a Shinkansen.
choice_data_list:
I definitely couldn't have done this 
before.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the old me might not believe her 
ears if she heard this.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So I am able to do it after all. To 
casually travel all the way out here, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...With you by my side, I feel as though 
we could even reach outer space.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well now. It's still too early to head 
back. Shall we do something to commemorate 
the occasion?
choice_data_list: Commemorative Photo at a Photo Spot

Go out for a celebratory feast to mark the 
occasion
Go buy a commemorative souvenir

text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It's quite difficult to take a good 
shot. Balancing it with the scenery is 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Um, would you like me to take a picture 
for you? And maybe, while we're at it, you 
could take one of us—
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you so much! I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Alright then! Both of you, make a big 
heart together, please!
choice_data_list: Heart?

text_block_list.name: Tourist
text_block_list.text:
? You don't know it? It's the trendiest 
pose right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. ...Then let us have them take the 
photo over there.

text_block_list.name: Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Looking great! Alright, I'll take a 
few shots... Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: They took such a lovely photo of us.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll need to print it out later.
Yeah, gotta print it out later.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...... Was Heart getting a bit too carried 
away?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That had a truly refined flavor, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To think this is only the 'Plum' tier. I 
wonder what kind of dishes 'Pine' and 
'Bamboo' are...
choice_data_list:
...Are you really sure the cheapest one 
was fine?

...Are you really sure the cheapest one is 
okay?

text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, after much deliberation, I 
ended up choosing the "Plum" course 
myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no. Any more luxury than this might 
actually just tire me out.
choice_data_list: Haha! Actually, me too.
Fufu! Actually, me too.

text_block_list.text:
“We'll save the ‘Bamboo’ grade and above 
for another time.” Saying that, I took a 
sip of hot tea.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, maybe once I've filled up 
another new stamp book.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... Making a proposal like this without 
asking about Trainer's circumstances...)
choice_data_list: Got it. It's a promise, okay?
Got it. It's a promise, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Assuming we buy some food for my 
parents... what should we get for 
ourselves?"
choice_data_list:
Something that feels special would be 
nice.

Something that feels special would be 
nice, right?

text_block_list.text:
And so, as we browsed souvenir shops one 
by one to see if anything caught our eye—
choice_data_list: —Ah. This is...

text_block_list.text:
What caught my eye was a silver hairpin, 
with tiny white flowers swaying gracefully 
on it.

Modest, yet with an inner core of 
strength, standing straight and poised, 
just like a certain someone's silhouette—
choice_data_list:
Hey, Messiah. I want you to have this 
hairpin—
Say, Messiah. This hairpin is for you—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san. I'd like to give this pin 
badge to you—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.text:
"...We stare at each other for a few 
seconds before realizing what's happening. 
It seems both of us had picked out 
souvenirs for each other."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. To think something like this would 
happen... Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, this worked out quite nicely. 
...Here, let me give this to you.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give this to you.
Then I'll give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...I will cherish it with extra care.
